description: This PHP script is a command-line installer for the OrangeHRM system. It handles setup tasks such as database creation, configuration, and initial admin user setup, including license agreement validation and dependency checks.

classes.name: UserCredential
classes.description: Data transfer object for user credentials, used for database and admin user setup.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration class with static method to check if the system is already installed.

classes.name: MemorySessionStorage
classes.description: Session storage implementation for in-memory session management.

classes.name: ServiceContainer
classes.description: Dependency injection container for managing services.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: Constants or identifiers for various services used in dependency injection.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: Initializes the HTTP environment for the installer.

classes.name: AppSetupUtility
classes.description: Utility class for setting up the application, including database and configuration.

classes.name: StateContainer
classes.description: Singleton class for storing and retrieving setup state information.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, used here to simulate a POST request for API handling.

classes.name: InstallerDataRegistrationAPI
classes.description: API handler for registering installer data, invoked at the end of the setup process.

methods.name: storeDbInfo
methods.description: Stores database connection information in the state container.

methods.name: setDbType
methods.description: Sets the type of database (new or existing) in the state container.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates the database for the application.

methods.name: createDBUser
methods.description: Creates the database user for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: writeConfFile
methods.description: Writes configuration files for the application.

methods.name: writeKeyFile
methods.description: Writes encryption key files if data encryption is enabled.
